provenance: Actual NewsService, prepared-news and scheduler with real temporary index/audio files. HTTP, credentials and room-state storage boundary are fixtures. No live provider calls or real credentials.

reports.scenario: durable boundaries, separate policies, source merging and idempotent completion
empty and partial source outcomes do not generate filler
unselected candidates are scoped to editorial configuration
cancelled writing pauses and explicit Resume reuses the selected story
restart after speech failure resumes saved text without reselecting or rewriting
server output constraints override conflicting user preferences
failed selection persistence blocks all downstream provider calls
publication receipt wins over a failed final index commit
changed configuration and expired checkpoints cannot silently resume
a selected story consumed elsewhere cannot trigger another paid retry
malformed sources, duplicate candidates and contradictory phases fail closed
definitive provider rejection pauses scheduled work without automatic paid retries
startup reconciles a completed recording after the room status write fails, once
